name: captra-monorepo
description: The capability-first framework for type-safe, memory-aware agentic applications.

scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test -w @captra-ai/core && npm run test -w @captra-ai/state && npm run test -w @captra-ai/client && npm run test -w @captra-ai/server && npm run test -w @captra-ai/postgres && npm run test -w @captra-ai/openai && npm run test -w @captra-ai/react && npm run test -w @captra-ai/devtools && npm run test -w @captra-ai/cli && npm run check:scaffold
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:example
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @captra-ai/core && npm run build -w @captra-ai/state && npm run build -w @captra-ai/client && npm run build -w @captra-ai/server && npm run build -w @captra-ai/react && npm run build -w @captra-ai/devtools && npm run build -w @captra-ai/postgres && npm run build -w @captra-ai/openai && npm run build -w captra
